title: Executive Presence: Authority with Warmth
description: Xây dựng phong thái lãnh đạo (Executive Presence): đĩnh đạc, trầm ấm và quyết đoán.

coreVocabulary.viDefinition: sự đĩnh đạc, uy nghiêm lãnh đạo
coreVocabulary.contextSentence: Gravitas is reflected in measured speech, emotional poise, and decisive judgment.
A charismatic leader projects both formidable strength and deep empathy.
Remaining centered with poise under crisis reassures anxious employees.
